chapter: Melvin Moore, Hammond and the New York trip
title: Melvin Moore doubts it was really John Hammond
summary: Melvin thinks Hammond with a hole in his trousers could not be the millionaire.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: So we went on and I don't know if I even heard from him--I might have heard from him one time perhaps before then, but all of them wondered, he was so excited about the band, just wondered, was that Hammond. So Melvin Moore,--he just flipped over Melvin-- and Melvin was a younger man than me but it looked like he wasn't excited as I was, he just wondered too if that was Hammond. So he finally said to me, do you think that was Hammond; I said yeah, why not? He said I just don't believe that was John Hammond, John Hammond is a millionaire. I said I know that too, he's one of the things that practically made Benny Goodman, that's his brother in law, spent that money on him. He said, did you look at that (inaudible).
He had a hole in his pants?
So I said no, I didn't pay any attention; he said I hope so, but I just don't
believe that was John Hammond. So I said, let us all hope it was.
